_about: Read by `egeria-upgrade-reset infra-check` (compose-configs/egeria-quickstart/bin). extraComposeFiles: more compose files to check, relative to the repo root (e.g. an optional runtime once the owner decides its state). expectedStopped: services deliberately down, each {"service", "reason", "by"}, optionally "exitCode" (how it must have stopped; another exit code is a FAIL); they report EXPECTED STOPPED instead of FAIL. Empty lists = shared-infra.yaml only, nothing expected stopped. prefect: optional; when present, two read-only rows: "Prefect server" (API health) and, per pool, "Prefect pool <name> live workers" (a worker is live when Prefect says ONLINE, else when its heartbeat is within 3x its interval). Both are WARN at worst, never FAIL: RE runs steps in its own process when no worker is live. Remove the entry where Prefect is not deployed.

expectedStopped.reason: a one-shot setup container: it migrates the Airflow database and exits
